rawContent: One of the reasons I’m not on Facebook now is that every time I posted something, some dude felt entitled to a lengthy intellectual, “non-emotional” debate w/ me about feminism or #metoo. I’m 100% done with that. You want to debate me, pay me. And I’ll bring my emotions, thanks.

I’m not glad about the Arrested Development interview, but I am glad it’s shining a light on something that’s gotten really overlooked amidst very important #metoo stories: not all abuse is sexual, and that shouldn’t be the bar we set for appropriate behavior at work.
